name: 44144 · Brooklyn, OH
findings: ZIP 44144 (Brooklyn) has 717 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (11%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44144 (Brooklyn) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
